_comment: PLAN-VISUALS Track D: ambientCG CC0 PBR sets used only by the Realistic terrain twins (unreal/apply_terrain_real_materials.py). Whole site CC0 1.0 (public domain, no login; see https://ambientcg.com/about). Fetched at 2K-JPG by `python content_src/textures/ground/download_ground_textures.py content_src/realistic/terrain/manifest.json` into <asset_id>/ (gitignored); imported to /Game/OpenDrive/Realistic/Terrain/<asset_id>/ by apply_terrain_real_materials.py.

textures.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
textures.notes: Grey bedded (sedimentary-looking) cliff rock - triplanar steep terrain and road-cut walls in M_GroundStylized_real, under the procedural strata tint. Replaces Rock030 there.

textures.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
textures.notes: Leaf litter, needles and roots - forest-floor layer of M_GroundStylized_real (replaces the mossy-stone Ground068).

textures.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
textures.notes: Real moss for the up-facing sides of the boulders in M_Rock030_real (replaces the Ground068 stand-in).

textures.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
textures.notes: Crushed grey stone - road shoulder in M_GroundStylized_real and the gravel patches of M_Embankment_real.

textures.author: ambientCG
textures.notes: Only the height map of the set content_src/textures/ground/ already uses for the boulders: M_Rock030_real's Nanite tessellated displacement (world triplanar) on the SM_RockBoulder*_real_high/_ultra twins.
